messages:
Jordan: Hey team — POC with Nimbus Health is hitting intermittent 429s during load tests. Happens after a burst of ~10-15 requests, mostly on /v1/generate. Can someone help triage? We're in week-1 POC.

Priya: Thanks Jordan. Can you paste one of the failing responses (headers + body) and the request size (approx tokens)?

Jordan: Here's one of the failing responses: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2026 14:12:03 GMT
Retry-After: 3
X-RateLimit-Limit: 10
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 164
X-Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3d
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"rate_limit","message":"per-route burst capacity exceeded"}
```

Jordan: Note — these requests are big, roughly ~4200 tokens each (long patient notes).

Lina: That looks like per-route burst rejects. Our rate-limiter is leaky-bucket + burst window. If the customer is sending big token requests, each counts heavily against the token-budget as well. @Sam can you check runtime logs for tenant=nimbus?

Sam: Pasting runtime extract: 
```
2026-03-20T14:11:59Z runtime.INFO rate_limiter.reject tenant=nimbus route=/v1/generate current=12 limit=10 window_ms=1000 reason=burst_limit request_id=req_0a1b2c3d
2026-03-20T14:12:01Z runtime.WARN policy.token_budget.exhausted tenant=nimbus used_tokens=198400 budget_per_min=200000
```

Sam: Confirmed: per-route concurrent RPS limit is 10, burst_capacity observed at 12 causing rejects; token budget near exhaustion for the minute.

Alex: From sales side — customer wants spike handling during demo; short-term lift might be fine. What's the safe quick fix?

Lina: Options: 
- Reduce client concurrency / introduce client-side rate limiter.
- Switch to smaller model for long inputs (fewer tokens).
- Increase per-route burst_capacity and/or per-minute token_budget for Nimbus temporarily via admin override.

Priya: Can we apply a temporary override? If so, what API/command?

Sam: I can apply a scoped override for the POC. Example admin API call: 
```
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/admin/quotas/overrides"
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
 -H "Content-Type: application/json"
 -d '{"customer":"nimbus","overrides":{"routes":{"/v1/generate":{"rate_limit_per_sec":10,"burst_capacity":25}},"token_budget_per_min":300000},"expires_at":"2026-03-20T15:00:00Z"}'
```

deploy-bot: Override accepted — nimbus:/v1/generate burst_capacity set to 25, token_budget_per_min=300000, expires 2026-03-20T15:00:00Z (audit id: ov_9f8e7d).

Jordan: Applying client-side limiter now and retrying load tests.

Jordan: Update 14:25 — After override, no 429s in 20m of tests. Thanks all :tada: Will follow up to set proper quota if POC continues.
